description_en: Queries the details of stack instances associated with a specified stack group
description_zh: 查询指定资源栈组关联的资源栈实例详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-stack-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-group-name MyStackGroup --stack-instance-account-id 1512666876910000 --stack-instance-region-id cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStackInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈组所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the stack group. The name must be unique within a region. The name can be up to 255 characters in length, and must start with a digit or a letter. It can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组名称。名称在单个地域内唯一。  
长度不超过255个字符，必须以数字或英文字母开头，可以包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: stack_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the execution account to which the stack belongs.

In the self-managed permissions pattern, this account is an Alibaba Cloud account.

In the service-managed permissions pattern, this account is one of the member accounts of a resource folder.

For more information about execution accounts, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈所属目标账号ID。

自助管理权限模式下，该账号是阿里云账号。

服务管理权限模式下，该账号是资源目录的成员账号。

关于目标账号的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html
parameters.name: stack_instance_account_id

parameters.help_en: The region to which the stack belongs
parameters.name: stack_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the Outputs parameter (the list of stack outputs). Valid values:  

Enabled: returns the Outputs parameter.  

Disabled: does not return the Outputs parameter. This is the default value.  
Calculating Outputs is time-consuming. If you do not need the Outputs information, set OutputOption to Disabled to improve the API response speed
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回Outputs参数（资源栈输出列表）。取值：  

Enabled：返回Outputs参数。  

Disabled（默认值）：不返回Outputs参数。  
Outputs计算较为耗时。如果不需要获取Outputs信息，建议您将OutputOption指定为Disabled，提高接口响应速度
parameters.name: output_option

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the execution account to which the stack belongs

DriftDetectionTime.description_en:
The time when the last successful drift detection was performed on the stack group. The time is displayed in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format.

This parameter is returned only if drift detection has been performed on the stack group
DriftDetectionTime.description_zh:
资源栈组最近一次成功完成偏差检测的时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss。

仅当资源栈组做过偏差检测，才会返回该参数

Outputs.description_en:
The list of stack outputs.  

This parameter is returned when OutputOption is set to Enabled
Outputs.description_zh:
资源栈输出列表。  

当OutputOption取值为Enabled时返回该参数

items.description_en:
The list of stack outputs.  

This parameter is returned when OutputOption is set to Enabled
items.description_zh:
资源栈输出列表。  

当OutputOption取值为Enabled时返回该参数

ParameterKey.description_en: The key of the parameter override

ParameterValue.description_en: The value of the parameter override

RdFolderId.description_en:
The ID of the folder in the resource directory.

This parameter is returned only for stack groups that use the service-managed permissions mode
RdFolderId.description_zh:
资源目录的资源夹ID。

仅限使用服务管理权限模式的资源栈组，才会返回该参数

RegionId.description_en: The region to which the stack belongs

StackDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift status of the stack instance based on the last successful drift detection.

Valid values:
DRIFTED: The stack instance has drifted.
NOT_CHECKED: No successful drift detection has been performed on the stack instance.
IN_SYNC: The stack instance is in sync.

This parameter is returned only if drift detection has been performed on the stack group
StackDriftStatus.description_zh:
资源栈组最近一次成功完成偏差检测的状态。

取值：
DRIFTED：资源栈处于偏差状态。
NOT_CHECKED：资源栈未进行过成功的偏差检测。
IN_SYNC：资源栈处于同步状态。

仅当资源栈组做过偏差检测，才会返回该参数

StackGroupId.description_en: The ID of the stack group

StackGroupName.description_en: The name of the stack group

StackId.description_en:
The ID of the stack.

This parameter is returned only when the status of the stack instance is CURRENT
StackId.description_zh:
资源栈ID。

仅当资源栈状态为CURRENT时，才会返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the stack instance.

Valid values:

CURRENT: The stack instance is up to date.

OUTDATED: The stack instance is not up to date with the stack group. Possible causes:
    - The stack instance failed to be created during the CreateStackInstances operation.
    - The stack instance failed to be updated or was only partially updated during the UpdateStackInstances or UpdateStackGroup operation.
    - The creation or update operation is not complete
Status.description_zh:
资源栈的状态。

取值：

CURRENT：资源栈是最新的。

OUTDATED：资源栈不是资源栈组最新的。可能原因如下：
    - 在创建资源栈（CreateStackInstances）操作期间，创建对应的资源栈失败。
    - 在更新资源栈（UpdateStackInstances或UpdateStackGroup）操作期间，更新对应的资源栈失败，或只更新了部分资源栈。
    - 创建或更新操作未完成

StatusReason.description_en:
The reason for instance status.

This parameter is returned only when instance status of the stack instance is OUTDATED
StatusReason.description_zh:
状态原因描述。

仅当资源栈的实例状态为OUTDATED时，才会返回该参数
